The option list matches a future-interests question, so I’m checking the workspace for the original stem before choosing between the two keyed answers.**D. Reversions.** A reversion is always vested and lies outside the Rule Against Perpetuities, while contingent remainders, executory interests, and vested remainders subject to open all fall within it. The phrase “with the intent to commit a felony therein” is burglary’s mental state and does not classify any of these interests.
